methods.platform: macOS 10.15+, Ubuntu 20.04+/Debian 10+, native Windows with Git for Windows/Git Bash; Node.js 18+, 4 GB RAM
methods.install_command: npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code; for a reviewed pin use @2.1.276
methods.privileges: Avoid sudo; user-writable npm prefix required. Administrator provisioning is outside the automated method.
methods.auto_update: Enabled by default; startup and periodic background updates. Disable with claude config set autoUpdates false --global or DISABLE_AUTOUPDATER=1.
methods.pin: npm exact package version syntax is available. Disable Claude auto-updates to preserve the selected version.
methods.integrity_verification: No vendor digest/signature and Anza verification procedure established by cited sources; classify install as manual. Do not substitute npm registry metadata for vendor release verification.
methods.auth_and_configuration: Claude subscription sign-in is separate from OpenRouter environment configuration; preserve cached authentication unless participant explicitly switches.
methods.limits: Documented platform minima do not qualify every distro, CPU architecture, native Windows ARM, or feature combination. No native test or sign-in was run.

methods.limits: Documentation only; no credentials, endpoint call or tool invocation tested.
